tickets.title: Display existing organization as static text for existing project members in Add Members modal
tickets.description: In the Add Members modal, when a user is staged to be added to a contract, the system should check whether that user is already a member of the current project (via any other contract in the same project). If they are, their organization assignment should be displayed as read-only static text showing their existing organization name — not as an editable dropdown. If the user is new to the project, they should still see the editable organization dropdown to select their org. Additionally, prevent duplicate members: if a user is already a member of the current contract, flag them as a duplicate and show a warning. On Save, persist members with their assigned organizations.
acceptance_criteria: When a staged member is already in the project (in any contract), their organization is shown as read-only static text — not an editable dropdown
The static text shows the member's EXISTING organization name from the project, not the currently selected dropdown value
When a staged member is new to the project, the editable organization dropdown is shown as normal
The UI correctly distinguishes between existing-project-members and new-project-members using a dedicated boolean flag (e.g. isExistingMemberInProject)
The TypeScript controller (add-members.component.ts) calls a backend service/API to determine if the staged user has an existing organization in the project
Duplicate contract members are flagged with isDuplicate=true and a warning is shown
On Save, members are persisted with their assigned organizations
